knowledge_mcq.design_note: Headline finding, phrasing 1: A asserts a single predominant task-oriented purpose; B asserts heterogeneity; distractors substitute alternative single-purpose hypotheses.
options: The primary purpose predominating is completing the informational, technical, or administrative operation itself
The primary purpose predominating is advancing the user's own personal or professional standing
No single purpose predominates; requests serve varied underlying purposes bound together by being task-led
The primary purpose predominating is benefiting people other than the user
knowledge_mcq.prompt: When the underlying purpose behind ordinary AI-assistant requests is characterized in aggregate, which description best matches the central finding?

knowledge_mcq.design_note: Headline finding, phrasing 2, different option ordering to vary correct-answer position.
options: Advancing the user's own personal or professional standing is what predominates
Completing the operation itself is what predominates
Benefiting people other than the user is what predominates
No objective reliably dominates; purposes vary while interactions remain task-led
knowledge_mcq.prompt: What does the aggregate evidence say about whether one underlying objective dominates everyday assistant use?

knowledge_mcq.design_note: Meaning/qualification item on scope of the claim, testing what is explicitly disclaimed.
options: It does not claim assistants track user identity, only that advancing one's own standing predominates
It does not claim assistants verify outcomes, only that benefiting others predominates
It does not claim every use serves the operation itself, only that completing the operation predominates in aggregate
It does not claim task completion is always the ultimate end, only that interactions are task-led with heterogeneous underlying purposes
knowledge_mcq.prompt: Which statement correctly captures what the finding does NOT claim?

knowledge_mcq.design_note: Meaning/qualification item on identical surface requests versus underlying purpose.
options: The same request always signals the user's intent to gain advantage over others
The same request always signals an intent to help someone besides the requester
The same request can be issued for different reasons, and no single reason dominates the aggregate
The same request can be issued for different reasons, yet in aggregate the operation itself remains the dominant read
knowledge_mcq.prompt: If two people submit an identical request, what does the finding imply about their underlying reasons?

knowledge_mcq.design_note: Evidence characterization item on methodology and what it converges on.
options: Purpose-coding of anonymized interactions and economic-index decompositions converge on the operation itself as the predominant purpose
Purpose-coding of anonymized interactions and economic-index decompositions converge on advancing one's own standing as the predominant purpose
Purpose-coding of anonymized interactions and economic-index decompositions converge on benefiting others as the predominant purpose
Purpose-coding of anonymized interactions and economic-index decompositions converge on heterogeneity of purpose beneath task-led requests
knowledge_mcq.prompt: How does the literature that produced this finding typically characterize its evidence base?

knowledge_mcq.design_note: Evidence characterization item on cross-setting consistency of purpose estimates.
options: Advancing the user's own personal or professional standing recurs as predominant regardless of setting
Completing the operation itself recurs as predominant regardless of which population or task class is examined
Purpose estimates vary across settings and coding choices, with no objective recurring as predominant across them
Benefiting people other than the user recurs as predominant regardless of setting
knowledge_mcq.prompt: Across different populations and task classes, how consistent are purpose estimates according to the described literature?

knowledge_mcq.design_note: Second-order implication item on how the typical user's motive is characterized.
options: As someone seeking to outmaneuver others for personal gain
As someone acting mainly on behalf of others' welfare
As someone whose request terminates in getting the operation done
As someone who cannot be characterized by one default motive beyond having some task at hand
knowledge_mcq.prompt: How is the assistant's typical interlocutor understood as a second-order consequence of the finding?

knowledge_mcq.design_note: Second-order implication item, alternate angle on framing of the assistant's role.
options: As a competitive instrument for personal advancement
As a charitable instrument for aiding others
As general infrastructure serving a mixture of ends
As a functional tool for closing out operations
knowledge_mcq.prompt: Which description best matches how commentary frames the assistant's role given the finding?

knowledge_mcq.design_note: Stability/trajectory item on how durability of the finding is described.
options: The predominance of completing the operation itself is treated as an established, settled characterization
The predominance of advancing the user's own personal or professional standing is treated as an established, settled characterization
The predominance of benefiting others is treated as an established, settled characterization
The settled premise is that purposes remain plural, not that any one purpose has become predominant
knowledge_mcq.prompt: How does the literature describe the durability of this finding over time?

knowledge_mcq.design_note: Stability/trajectory item, alternate angle on change versus persistence over time.
options: The share of interactions aimed at advancing the user's own standing has held steady as usage has broadened
The operation-completion objective has held steady as usage has broadened, recovered by independent purpose-coding methods
The share of interactions aimed at benefiting others has held steady as usage has broadened
The composition of purposes can shift over time while heterogeneity itself persists across settings
knowledge_mcq.prompt: As assistant usage has broadened over time, what has the literature reported about the finding's trajectory?
